g.text: FP8 / FP16: six matched physical-kernel families
48 tested cases · stage shapes derived from each input resolution · lower latency is better
Pooled medians; whiskers span the medians of the two execution orders. Order-dependent reversals remain visible.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Six of 36 selected entries per precision. This is a kernel pilot comparison, not a complete FP16 trunk or DLL-host benchmark.
